item.title: Ex-judge to decide if Vancouver constables must apologize in person to Heiltsuk pair
item.description: British Columbia's Office of the Police Complaint Commissioner has appointed a retired judge to determine if two officers who wrongfully handcuffed an Indigenous man and his granddaughter outside a Vancouver bank in 2019 should be required to provide an oral apology "consistent with Indigenous law."
